title: 18.23. Upādānagocchakādi, Hetuduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Upādānaṁ hetuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca noupādāno nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā cattāri …pe… vipāke ekaṁ …pe… avigate cattāri.
Kilesaṁ hetuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nokileso nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā cattāri …pe… vipāke ekaṁ …pe… avigate cattāri. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
